part1.title: The Last Lighthouse (1/3): Something Blinked Back #shorts
part1.description:
For three years you've kept the lighthouse burning for ships that never come.
Tonight, something out in the storm blinks back: S.O.S. Child on board.

Would you go? Part 2 is up next.
#shorts #animation #survival #story #storytime
part1.comment: Would you row out into that storm? 🌊 Yes or no 👇

part2.title: The Last Lighthouse (2/3): Into The Storm #shorts
part2.description:
A girl in a yellow raincoat. A capsized boat. And the lighthouse just went dark.

How would you save them? Part 3 is the finale.
#shorts #animation #survival #story #storm
part2.comment: How would YOU get the light back on? 🔦 Best idea 👇

part3.title: The Last Lighthouse (3/3): Burn It All - The Finale #shorts
part3.description:
No power. No fuel. Dozens of boats heading for the rocks.
A lighthouse doesn't need electricity. It needs fire.

What would you burn to keep the light on? New story tomorrow.
#shorts #animation #survival #emotional #ending
